description: This file defines the Reward model class for the OpenCart platform. It contains methods to manage customer rewards, including adding, deleting, retrieving rewards, and calculating totals. The class interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to customer rewards.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model class managing customer reward points, including adding, deleting, fetching, and computing totals for customer rewards.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Creates a new reward record for a customer, inserting data such as customer ID, order ID, description, points, and date into the database.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a given customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward entries associated with a specific order ID, only for entries with negative points.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward records for a customer with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of points for a customer, accounting for both positive and negative rewards.
